scope: Current authored math.4.numtheory semantic graph mathematics, full graph/page coverage, actual emitted SVG/3D relations, local DOM controls and controlled-font label-layout execution. No server, browser, real-browser font inspection, production delivery or cryptographic security certification by this reviewer.
independent_scientific_methods: Python arbitrary-precision divmod, math.gcd, modular pow and direct integer coefficient substitution validate graph values and relations independently of runtime helpers.
Actual partition memberships are counted, every signed remainder/back-substitution row is substituted into original inputs, and conditional binary-circuit arities/invariants are checked.
Prime-power leaf products and prime certificates are checked against all possible small divisors; product-plus-one divisors are checked against the actual finite list.
Totient exclusion sets start with all n residue classes including zero, remove actual surviving multiples of each distinct prime, and finish with the complete gcd-based unit set.
Euler maps are compared with the complete independent unit set; image bijectivity, both modular products, invertible cancellation and failed hypotheses are checked.
RSA factor products, candidate/actual totient separation, private inverse, every message for four toy keys and both zero/nonzero CRT branches are independently checked.
Every page is compared with the complete producer graph for exact node, edge and witness identity; context endpoints and stable full-graph display IDs remain intact.

Actual sphere/line/arrow primitives are inspected for values, calibrated coordinates, directed endpoints, self-loop geometry and arrow direction. Actual rendered SVG paths attach to their visible circle/rectangle boundaries.
Actual SVG rectangle/circle bounds are checked for distinct anchors, nonintersection and inclusion in the SVG for all default pages and original endpoint states.
Actual DOM node keys, relation lists, witness payloads, native commits, peer updates, page clamps, null setters, reset, speech callbacks and keyboard scrolling are executed.

Actual SVG circle and line projections under three cameras are compared with an independent rigid rotation/perspective-free projection calculation; getBBox uses a controlled 8-pixel-character/14-pixel-height fixture, not a claim about browser fonts.

It retains exactly 64 values and reports complete=true,prefix=0,period=64 for base 3 mod 256. The graph closes cycle63 to cycle0 directly from this corrected helper metadata and the proof text agrees. Base 3 mod 512 remains complete=false with null prefix/period and a separately calculated next residue 257. Current compensatory graph metadata was removed; historical source and receipts remain preserved.

evidence_boundaries: A complete graph means every authored semantic node and relation is retained. Large division counts remain exact aggregates; literal unit dots are emitted only for declared small partitions.

The stored power table is bounded to 64 distinct entries. The arithmetic helper recognizes a repeated next residue even at that boundary; otherwise no period is asserted. Graph closure and model proof use that same helper metadata, while genuinely unclosed graphs show a separate exact continuation.
Stable N IDs are stable across pages/cameras within the current complete graph; the visible key retains exact role/value labels and the witness panel retains complete set/edge data.
Node placement, card spacing, depth, color and sphere size are layout choices, not integer magnitude, cryptographic difficulty or proof strength.
Controlled getBBox checks test the measured-slot algorithm and key coupling. Actual browser fonts/responsive layout are owned by the separate reader review.
Finite tests verify calculations and representations; general proofs were inspected as quantified arguments, not mechanically proved.
Tiny raw RSA remains educational and insecure. rfcPublicBounds identifies a subset of key parameter bounds, not full conformity or security.
